name: tap-pass-desktop
description: Desktop spot-check (1280x900, no touch) that the mobile tap-target rules did not grow desktop controls.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; (function(){ const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); s.setUiMode?.('pro'); s.reresolveFeatureFlags?.(); })()

steps.name: measure-catalog
steps.eval: (() => { const chip=document.querySelector('.catalog .chip'); const tab=document.querySelector('.catalog .tab'); const pg=document.querySelector('.catalog .pager button'); const srch=document.querySelector('.catalog .cat-search .input'); const h=el=>el?Math.round(el.getBoundingClientRect().height):'n/a'; const o=document.createElement('div'); o.style.cssText='position:fixed;top:8px;left:8px;z-index:2147483647;background:#111;color:#0f0;font:13px monospace;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:6px'; o.textContent='DESKTOP catalog heights → chip:'+h(chip)+' tab:'+h(tab)+' pager:'+h(pg)+' search:'+h(srch)+' px'; document.body.appendChild(o); })()
